test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following leads to global warming?

options.text: Increase in CO₂ percentage in the air
Increase in the levels of atmospheric ozone

solution:
The correct answer is **'__Increase in CO₂ percentage in the air__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fossil fuels – coal, oil and gas** are by far the largest contributor to global climate change, accounting for over 75 per cent of global greenhouse gas emissions and nearly 90 per cent of all carbon dioxide emissions.
 
• As greenhouse gas emissions blanket the Earth, they trap the sun's heat.
 
• The main cause of global warming is the **excess of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.** 
 
• **Carbon dioxide is the major greenhouse gas.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• “Global warming” refers to** the rise in global temperatures due mainly to the increasing concentrations of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.**
 
• “Climate change” refers to the increasing changes in the measures of climate over a long period of time – including precipitation, temperature, and wind patterns.
